decisions.decision: Fixed 6 bugs live during UAT instead of routing through the diagnose->plan->execute gap pipeline

decisions.decision: dev build-id via Vite plugin (virtual:build-id, re-stamped on handleHotUpdate), NOT git-hash or load-timestamp
decisions.rationale: Must be cache-proof: a load-timestamp lies (cached code stamps fresh time). Plugin id is baked into the bundle + changes only on code change -> true stale-vs-latest signal. No commit/restart/manual bump. Read live via: curl -s http://localhost:5173/@id/virtual:build-id
